metadata.ut_note: All Julian Days are UT; inputs treated as UTC (UT ~= UTC here).
metadata.notes: Rise/set events keyed by the LOCAL civil date of the event in the city's timezone. Each event has two entries: 'D-1', 'D', 'D+1' (relative to the requested date D), each carrying two conventions: 'upper_limb_refraction' (swe.rise_trans default: upper limb, standard refraction) and 'disc_center_no_refraction' (BIT_DISC_CENTER | BIT_NO_REFRACTION). atpress/attemp left at swisseph defaults (1013.25 mbar, 15 C), observer elevation 0 m.
